label: s2_sub_009_botan_01
text: Wha—? Guys! What are you all doing here?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_sub_009_fairy_04
text: Yeesh. Busted.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: s2_sub_009_botan_02
text: Um... I was just walking down the hall and saw\nyou all in here...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_sub_009_botan_03
text: B-but that’s fine! No one asked me to join, so I\nshould just leave, shouldn’t I?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_sub_009_botan_04
text: S-sorry about that. See you later![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_sub_009_doku_04
text: Lady Penny, wait![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_10
text: It’s not what you think, Penny! Hear us out![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: s2_sub_009_aku_06
text: So what happened was...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: s2_sub_009_botan_05
text: Phew... I thought you’d all decided not to talk to\nme anymore.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_11
text: We would never![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_12
text: That’s what it must’ve looked like though, huh.\nSorry we made you worry.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: s2_sub_009_honoo_16
text: We just didn’t wanna drag you into another one\nof our messes... Our bad, Penny.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: s2_sub_009_botan_06
text: Well, apology NOT accepted![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_sub_009_fairy_05
text: ...Wait, for real?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: s2_sub_009_botan_07
text: Why do YOU guys get to decide that I’d just be\nweighed down by your problems?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_sub_009_botan_08
text: I...I’m your friend, right?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_sub_009_botan_09
text: So...you should come bother me more. Lean on\nme! That’s what’d actually make me happy...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_sub_009_doku_05
text: O, Lady Penny...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_009_botan_10
text: A-and if things get really bad, I can just hack into\nthe school system and fix your grades anyway![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_13
text: What?! That’s a terrible idea![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: s2_sub_009_aku_07
text: Yeah, isn’t that takin’ it a bit far?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: s2_sub_009_botan_11
text: Ah... Sorry. That was a joke![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_sub_009_botan_12
text: I was trying to lighten things up in here, but I\nguess that was pretty out of character...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_sub_009_honoo_17
text: Glad to hear it! If you were serious, I would’ve\nhad to pummel some sense into ya![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: s2_sub_009_botan_13
text: B-but about before! I’m actually a pretty good\ntutor, you know.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_sub_009_botan_14
text: So feel free to ask me for help with studying\nand stuff anytime![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_sub_009_doku_06
text: Lady Penny, we are honor’d by thy generosity.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_009_fairy_06
text: Ugh! Does that mean we gotta get lectured by\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)] AND Penny now?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: s2_sub_009_fairy_07
text: Well...I guess there are worse things.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: s2_sub_009_aku_08
text: Haha! Careful, my man—that was dangerously\nclose to a straight-up compliment![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: s2_sub_009_aku_09
text: You can just come right out and say you like the\nidea. We all know you’re thinkin’ it![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: s2_sub_009_doku_07
text: Indeed! I need not even use my ninja senses,\nso childishly apparent are thy true feelings![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: s2_sub_009_fairy_08
text: WHAT?! As if you know what’s in my head![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: s2_sub_009_fairy_09
text: You guys haven’t got the first clue about me![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: s2_sub_009_fairy_10
text: Try getting to know me better before spouting\nnonsense, huh?! You’re! All! The! WORST!!![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: s2_sub_009_honoo_18
text: Pff. H-hey guys? I...I think we broke Ortega![VAR 0x0114(001F)]
